text:
Use with caution / monitor. 

Rifampin is an inducer of cytochrome P450 enzymes—including CYP2C9, 1A2, and 3A4—which are responsible for metabolizing warfarin [rifampin:drug_interactions:1, warfarin:drug_interactions:2]. Because rifampin decreases the exposure of coadministered drugs that are substrates for these enzymes, it has the potential to decrease the anticoagulant effect (decrease the INR) of warfarin [rifampin:drug_interactions:1, warfarin:drug_interactions:2].
